column1: # The name table's vectors: run by tests/extractsafe.cjs (desktop/archsafe.cjs), KtNameSafe.java (tests/native/namesafe.sh)
# and kt-core's archsafe.rs (rustc --test). Columns (tab): kind, platform, input, action, out, reasons, flags.
# Escapes in input/out: \\ a backslash, \u{hex} a character. kind «name»: one component; «path»: a relative path;
# «set»: entries joined by « | », each f:path, d:path, s:path>target (symlink), h:path>target (hard link); its action
# column holds the problems sorted, «kind:path» joined by «,» («-» none), out/reasons/flags «-».
